solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Six at home in cathedral town or area nearby

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals

indicators.note: the word in tells us the home piece sits inside the cathedral town

parts.note: in Britain a city is traditionally a town with a cathedral
someone at home is in

explanation.surface: A puzzle about counting six people at home somewhere in or around a cathedral town.
explanation.definitionFit: The surrounding district is the neighbourhood or the area close by.

clue.text: Wickedness that gets a grip

definitions.meaning: a workbench tool with jaws that clamp and hold work firm

explanation.surface: Evil described as something that takes hold of a person.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both immorality and a clamping tool used in a workshop.

clue.text: Nasty dog — dog to put a restriction on

parts.note: a cur is a mean, snappy mongrel
to dog someone is to follow them, or tail them

explanation.surface: A vicious dog and an instruction about restraining a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'dog' is a verb meaning to follow closely.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut short or limit something is to restrict it.

clue.text: Observe directors providing facility for giving information

parts.note: to observe is to notice
a company's directors form its board

explanation.surface: Watch the company directors as they provide some way of informing staff.
explanation.definitionFit: A panel on a wall where announcements are pinned up serves to inform people.

clue.text: Very sad time with smoke going up

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: a cigar is something to smoke

explanation.surface: A sorrowful occasion with smoke rising, perhaps from a fire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going up' only works because this is a down entry: the smoke is read from the bottom of the grid upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deeply distressing or calamitous is very sad.

clue.text: Cut good wood

parts.note: ash is a tree and its timber

explanation.surface: A short instruction to cut some good-quality timber.
explanation.definitionFit: A long deep wound or slash is a cut.

clue.text: Blue haze, nothing extreme, over river

indicators.note: in a down entry, over means the first piece sits above the second
with nothing at its extremes, the word haze loses its first and last letters

parts.note: the Ure is a river in Yorkshire, a crossword favourite

explanation.surface: A blue haze hanging over a river, but not too extreme.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the bright sky-blue colour, a shade of blue.

clue.text: Crime involving academic pleasure-seeker

indicators.note: involving means the crime word takes the academic inside it

parts.note: a heist is a robbery
a don is a university lecturer, especially at Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: A robbery featuring a hedonistic university lecturer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone devoted to sensual enjoyment pursues pleasure above everything.

clue.text: Sign of something missing? React violently

indicators.note: violently means the letters of react are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: Noticing that something has gone and reacting violently.
explanation.definitionFit: A proofreader's insertion mark shows where a word or letter has been left out.

clue.text: A street dog not the first to bring surprise

indicators.note: not the first means the dog word drops its opening letter

parts.note: a hound is a dog

explanation.surface: A stray in the street that isn't the first one to cause astonishment.
explanation.definitionFit: To amaze someone greatly is to bring them surprise.

clue.text: Ducks are flying above shooters? All is revealed!

definitions.meaning: the quarry birds, the hunters' prey, are up in the air over the guns
a phrase said when a deception has been exposed

explanation.surface: A shooting party watching ducks overhead, then a sudden exclamation that the secret is out.
explanation.walkthrough: The first half reads the idiom literally: the hunted birds are aloft.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom is used when a trick is found out, and literally pictures quarry birds up in the air.

clue.text: Greek philosopher's man I reached when perplexed

indicators.note: perplexed suggests confused, so these letters are muddled up

explanation.surface: Someone baffled on reaching the man who wrote about a Greek thinker.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective relates to the ancient Syracusan mathematician of the lever and screw, a Greek thinker.

clue.text: Hear a gun going off in attack

indicators.note: going off suggests an explosion, so the letters are blown apart and rearranged

explanation.surface: Hearing a gun fire during an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: A forceful verbal tirade is an attack on someone.

clue.text: Odd remarks from bad lads written on outside of one book

indicators.note: written on the outside means the shuffled lads wrap round the next pieces
bad signals the letters of lads in a corrupted order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Strange comments by naughty boys scrawled on the cover of a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' scrambles LADS to ADLS, which goes round IB.
explanation.definitionFit: Improvised comments are occasional unscripted remarks.

clue.text: Fighting units that could become scared

indicators.note: could become means the letters of scared can be rearranged into a new word

explanation.surface: Soldiers' squads who might turn frightened.
explanation.definitionFit: Small groups of trained activists or soldiers form fighting units.

clue.text: Real pic? It's phoney copy

indicators.note: phoney means fake, so the letters of real pic are falsified into another order

explanation.surface: Is the photo genuine? No, it is a fake copy.
explanation.definitionFit: An exact reproduction is a copy of an original.

clue.text: An aroma rising

parts.note: an becomes the article A
a scent is an aroma

explanation.surface: A smell drifting upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A climb or upward movement is a rising.

clue.text: One sooty worker after a good wash winning all the prizes

indicators.note: after puts the worker piece behind the wash pieces

parts.note: to give something a good wash is to clean it
a chimney sweep gets covered in soot

explanation.surface: A chimney sweep scrubbing up after work, and somehow taking every award.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a total victory, taking every trophy on offer.

clue.text: Buddhist priest reported animal in the wild

indicators.note: reported means we want a word that sounds like the priest

parts.note: a lama is a Tibetan Buddhist monk

explanation.surface: A Tibetan monk spoke of a creature he saw roaming free.
explanation.definitionFit: This South American camelid is an animal of the Andes.

clue.text: The fellow gets about — but not there

parts.note: he refers to a male person
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A man travels around, but is not in that place.
explanation.definitionFit: In this place is the opposite of in that place.

clue.text: VIP enraged, having been messed about

indicators.note: messed about means the letters of enraged have been jumbled

explanation.surface: An important person, furious at being treated badly.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish nobleman, and so any person of high rank, is a very important person.

clue.text: Little son touching green filth

indicators.note: touching means the two pieces sit right against each other

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son
lime is a shade of green

explanation.surface: A small boy putting his hand into some green muck.
explanation.definitionFit: Unpleasant sticky ooze is a kind of filth.

clue.text: Once given a first in Mathematics — must have sat this

definitions.text: Once given a first in Mathematics — must have sat this

parts.note: ex means former, or once

indicators.note: first in picks the opening letter of the subject named

explanation.surface: Anyone once awarded a top degree in maths must have taken a test.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal test is what a student sits before being given a degree class.

clue.text: Work quietly in phase? Then standstill

indicators.note: in places the work and quiet pieces inside the phase word

parts.note: a stage is a phase
OP is short for opus, a work
P is piano, quietly in music

explanation.surface: A work schedule moving through quiet phases until things halt.
explanation.definitionFit: A halt in work or movement brings things to a standstill.
